comment: pacifist-bot band for --sim 5000 --policy pacifist. RE-BASELINED in batch 11 (combat-balance MAJOR; human sign-off 2026-07-22/23). Naively (pre-fix) this policy measured 3/5000 (0.06%) against the new guaranteed D3 mimic room; with the decline fix, 7/5000 (0.1%), 5 dark, deaths_combat 4988, spared 18934, kills_total 0 — still the dumb-mercy floor; band UNCHANGED ([0,4] brackets it with headroom).
